title: Combined effects of transition metal nitrogen and graphene nanoribbon edge active sites on the oxygen reduction reaction catalytic performance of metal–N–carbon-based catalysts
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20863-20871
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07513G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiao Hong Chen, Qiao Wu, Yupan Zhang, Junchao Xiong, Di Ma, Xiaoyu Xie, Jun Lin, Ying Wu, Hongjie Meng
Fe/Co–N–C-GNRs exhibit a high electrocatalytic activity for the ORR (onset and half-wave potentials of 0.95 and 0.83 V, respectively) and high durability, due to the combined effects of Fe–Nx, Co–Nx, FeCo–Nx, and GNR edge sites.
